name: Condition map for model-based waiting on B3 at calibration targets 0.92 and 0.94
reason: In the frozen condition map (b3_delay_map) every rule is calibrated to 0.90 per history, at which the per-history requirement was met in only part of the splits (fixed waits 8, B3-predictive 0-11, smoothing plus slope 4-14 of 20 per cell), and in the five 0.0025/2/d cells the B3-predictive rule fell back to threshold 0.99 without reaching the target. This study repeats the map at targets 0.92 and 0.94. Target 0.94 is the smallest pre-specified frontier target at which every frontier rule met the requirement in 20 of 20 splits at noise 0.005; it was chosen after that evaluation was seen. The frontier rules had no delay and 2-min sampling, and at noise 0.01 the frontier B3 belief met the requirement in 19 of 20 splits at 0.94; the map's rules at d > 0 or Delta > 2 min have not been evaluated at 0.94.
unchanged: Everything of configs/b3_delay_map_protocol.json except the calibration target: delays 0, 10, 20, 30, 40 min; sampling intervals 2, 6, 10 min; noise s.d. 0.0025, 0.005, 0.01; rules fixed (one wait per history), B3-predictive, B3 nowcast and smoothing plus slope (scales 2, 4, 8, 16 min); fine threshold grid; per-history calibration on calibration samples; the 20 splits and observation draws; the original classification ('model helps' when the B3-predictive rule is faster than smoothing plus slope in at least 16 of 20 splits and its median pooled success is at most 0.5 points below).
per_history_class: at each target, a cell is 'not classifiable' if the B3-predictive or the smoothing-plus-slope rule reached its calibration target for both histories in fewer than 16 of 20 splits; otherwise 'model helps' if the original condition holds and the B3-predictive rule met 0.9 for both histories in at least 16 of 20 splits; otherwise 'reporter suffices'
outputs: per map cell and target 0.92 and 0.94: splits meeting the per-history requirement per rule; splits in which each rule reached its calibration target for both histories; median, minimum and maximum of success (pooled and per history) and completion per rule; paired differences; splits in which the B3-predictive rule is faster than smoothing plus slope; map value; original and per-history class; cells whose original class differs between 0.90 and 0.94, with the faster-split count and the median success gap at both targets
headline: 0.94 is the primary map. The paper's statements about where the mechanistic model helps use only cells classified 'model helps' by the original rule at 0.90 and by the per-history rule at 0.94; cells whose class changes are described as target-dependent; Fig. 3(d) shows the 0.94 map values with those cells in bold; the 0.90 map stays in the repository and is cited
check: (1) target 0.90: choices identical and all success, completion and paired values within 1e-12 of delay_map_results.json, classes identical; (2) target 0.94, cells 0.005/2/0 and 0.01/2/0: b3_predictive and b3_nowcast equal the frontier B3-belief rule and fixed equals the frontier fixed rule at target 0.94 in all 20 splits (within 1e-12); (3) the fixed choices at a target are identical in all 45 cells of a split; (4) every choice with target_reached = true has calibration success >= its target; (5) leakage: inverting evaluation outcomes leaves the 0.94 choices of one job unchanged; (6) two jobs recomputed from scratch. If (1) or (2) fails, no 0.92/0.94 result is interpreted; a corrected version is frozen before the single rerun.
reporting: All results reported whatever their direction; simulation of one published model structure in which the B3 rules share the plant structure and the model is correct; targets are empirical calibration targets, not coverage guarantees.
